text:
release-captain: Heads-up: cutoff in ~90m. Code freeze goes into effect at 18:30 UTC. If you need a late merge, file an exception (reason, risk, testing) and ping me + eng-sre oncall. Docs-only and changelog bumps are preferred to land before freeze. :warning:
elin: quick q — I have a tiny docs-only PR that updates the changelog and bump in package.json (version patch). Is that okay to merge now?
release-captain: docs-only sounds fine — merge, then post the PR link here and run the smoke job. Make sure the changelog entry is under "Unreleased" and mentions the public impact. :thumbsup:
ben: I have a runtime tweak that requires a minor version bump (non-breaking). It touches the runtime adapter and needs a brief smoke run. Can I get an exception?
release-captain: Ben — that sounds risky for a late merge unless it's critical. Options: (1) hold for next window, (2) open an exception with a short test plan + who can revert, (3) if it's small and you can demonstrate a green smoke run and a revert PR, we might approve. File the exception in #release-exceptions and link it here.
lina: deploy-bot, can you confirm latest smoke pipeline status for main? I'm looking for the smoke that runs after merges.
deploy-bot: smoke/main - last run: 18:00 UTC — status: PASSED. Jobs: unit-smoke: PASS, integration-lite: PASS, canary-sim: PASS. Link: https://ci.internal/runs/67890
sam: If anyone needs a cherry-pick template, use this: `git checkout -b cherry/patch-<ticket>`
`git cherry-pick -x <commit>`
`git push origin cherry/patch-<ticket>`
Create PR against release branch. Also run `./scripts/run-smoke.sh --quick` before requesting review.
elin: merging docs PR now: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/9123 — ran quick smoke locally, no infra changes.
release-captain: Received, thanks. After merge, please tag the changelog entry and add `changelog: docs` label.
ben: I opened exception: https://go/internal/exception/302 — includes impact, revert plan, and smoke logs. Added sam as reviewer.
release-captain: Noted. I'll review and ping eng-sre. If we approve, please wait for explicit :heavy_check_mark: in this thread before merging.
lina: heads-up to teams: if you plan any DB migration, do NOT merge. We need migration window tomorrow.
sam: ben — if you want to pre-stage the cherry-pick, run the commands above and mark the PR `WIP: exception` so CI still runs. Helps speed approval.
release-captain: Final reminder: freeze is at 18:30 UTC. Exceptions accepted until 18:15 UTC with full docs & smoke. After that, emergency-only with oncall signoff. Thanks all.
